# Satisfaction Measurement

`customer_support.voice_of_customer.satisfaction_measurement` · v0.1.0 · **draft** · **STUB**

**What did the customer say about that interaction, and what is that answer actually evidence of?**


> Asking the customer how it went, and knowing what the answer is worth. The measurement is never a sample of the population — it is a sample of the emotionally aroused, so the score moves when the furious stop answering rather than when the service improves, and a team that manages the score directly will learn to survey selectively long before it learns to serve better. Effort is the more honest question because it asks what the interaction cost rather than how it felt, and it is the one that predicts whether the customer stays.
